Superbuy spreadsheet FAQ

See all FAQs
What is the Superbuy spreadsheet?

It is a searchable index of Weidian products from a saved FindSpreadsheet export. It provides item IDs, seller photos, reference prices and Superbuy links. The seller listing and Superbuy checkout show the current information.

How do I find an exact Weidian item?

Paste the numeric item ID, original Weidian URL or a Superbuy URL containing the original listing. For names, use a few specific product terms and narrow the results by category.

Can I search for a product using a photo?

Open Search by image next to the text search and choose a clear photo or cropped screenshot. The browser compares listing covers, gallery photos, saved QC photos and the site’s guide and brand images. Confirm the item ID because close visual matches can be different listings.

Are listing photos and warehouse QC the same?

Seller photos present a listing. Warehouse QC shows a unit that an agent received. Saved reference QC can come from earlier orders and agents. For your own parcel, use the inspection photos in your Superbuy account.

What if an item has no reference QC?

The product page labels saved QC when available and shows an empty state otherwise. Use listing images for design comparison and wait for your own warehouse photos before forwarding.

Does the USD price include shipping?

The displayed USD amount is converted from a saved CNY listing price. Verify the selected variant and domestic delivery at checkout. International freight, packing and other services can change the total.

How do I choose a size?

Read the seller’s chart for the exact variant. Tops: compare chest, shoulder and length. Pants: compare waist, rise and inseam. Shoes: check the seller’s size scale and foot-length guidance.

Can I ship multiple orders together?

When items are ready in My Warehouse, select the ones you want to send together. Compare packing options, route eligibility, actual and dimensional weight, and total cost before submitting.

What if the Superbuy product link cannot load?

Open the original Weidian listing first. If it is still available, copy it into Superbuy’s official search field. Follow the manual shopping-agent process if offered. If the listing is unavailable, search the catalog for another item.

Where do I check delivery and a problem with my order?

Use the parcel record or official tracking tool after dispatch. For a variant, missing part or visible damage, contact support through the relevant order and include the parcel or order number and clear photos.

Is this an official Superbuy store?

Superbuy Findsheet is an independent product directory. Registration, orders, payments and official support take place on Superbuy. This site may receive referral credit when you use sponsored links.
